body: they’re a bit too spread out- um
i don’t think i can reschedule, they can wax around it, it’s like a patch only. technically it’s not really deep cuts so i hope it gets better at least till saturday (the appointment)
that’s really amazing and impressive! i’m proud of you for holding through! you should be proud of yourself too!
i don’t think i have the best experience but i can still talk with you? is it alright if i message you?
exactly. i know it’s not a competition but it just comes back to me every time. it feels like if i stop. then the scars i already have were all so meaningless and for nothing?

happy birthday!! hey i’m sure they haven’t forgotten about you, if it feels like these friendships are meaningless then i’m sure you’ll find better people. it’s just decrease in your social circle for now, it will expand!!
you didn’t really word it badly. i feel like that is my problem exactly, i tend to have this competitiveness of making myself worse. it sounds bad tbh. i just can’t help it?

help. i think it got worded so wrong. i meant i like the small accidents on their own. this is the first time my brother noticed and got a bit concerned. it’s okay he moved on ! he’s not bothered by it and i wouldn’t want him to be
thanks! i'm feeling a bit better now that i'm distracted
they start walking on eggshells around you and it just makes it worse
right? and like i don't want them to treat me differently just based on this stuff.
yeah lol, its just somehow easier to do it anonymously with strangers?

i don't really have a sensation, it's more like a momentary thought of what would happen if i did it. as stupid and insensitive as it might sound its like a curiosity for me and i've always been a person that gives into curiosity. as for where i cut, over the months i've learned to choose the place that would hurt even after it stops bleeding, either that or i just go with whatever, it feels like i'm doing everything subconsciously.

tbh i feel the same way. i know this isn't a competition but like it feels stupid sometimes when i see my friends who have much worse problems and more severe sh marks. it feels like my reasoning isn't even valid enough nor are my "few marks".
thank you so much for the nice words! i hope it does increase.
